title: Open Neuromorphic - Community Architecture & Ecosystem Strategy
description: Co-developed the strategic vision and architected the digital ecosystem for a global open-source foundation of 2,500+ members, driving contributor engagement and unifying disparate projects into a cohesive network.
role_overview: As Vice-Chair, Justin co-leads the strategic vision and governance for the Open Neuromorphic foundation. As Lead Community Architect, he translates that strategy into tangible platforms and programs, designing the digital infrastructure and contributor pathways that empower a global community of over 2,500 members to collaborate effectively.

custom-web-application-development.summary: Architected and built the community's central hub (open-neuromorphic.org) and developed the ONM Mission Board, a CI/CD-powered platform to streamline community contributions.
points: Drove contributor growth by redesigning the community's digital hub with strategic 'contributor funnels' to guide new members toward active participation.
Conceived and launched the ONM Mission Board, a novel platform using GitHub Actions to aggregate 'help wanted' issues, creating a clear entry point for community contributions.
Established the ONM Collaboration Network, a formal DevRel program to unify foundational open-source tools and amplify their collective reach through strategic partnerships.

seo-content-strategy-optimization.summary: Executed a content and branding strategy that established the organization as a leading authority in its niche, achieving top search rankings and creating a consistent brand identity.
points: Developed the community’s branding, style guide, and an automated workflow to produce professional social media assets for all events and announcements.
Authored the official Sponsorship Policy, establishing community-first guidelines to protect editorial independence while fostering sustainable partnerships.
Achieved top-3 search rankings for core technical terms, establishing the community as a key authority and primary resource in the field.

title: AI Models Platform - Founder & Community Architect (Acquired)
description: Founded, built, and grew aimodels.org into a major hub for the open-source AI community, leading to its successful acquisition. Drove community engagement through platform development, content strategy, and large-scale technical showcases.
role_overview: As Founder, Justin led the entire lifecycle of aimodels.org, from a conceptual idea to a valuable community platform that was ultimately acquired. He architected the technical stack, drove the community growth strategy, and created high-impact engagement projects, demonstrating a full spectrum of skills from hands-on development to strategic ecosystem building.

custom-web-application-development.summary: Built the core platform and several satellite community sites, creating the technical foundation for a thriving open-source AI ecosystem.
points: Architected and built the scalable Hugo-based platform that served as the community's central hub.
Fostered a broader ecosystem by leading web development for fmcheatsheet.org and collaborating on open-neuromorphic.org.

seo-content-strategy-optimization.summary: Executed a highly successful organic growth strategy, achieving top search rankings for competitive terms and establishing the platform as a key discovery tool for the community.
points: Achieved #1 organic search results for competitive terms like 'Download AI Models', turning the site into a primary entry point for community members.
Drove substantial and sustained organic traffic growth, demonstrating effective community outreach and content strategy at scale.

ai-data-integration-services.summary: Engineered a large-scale audio pipeline that generated ~12,000 unique audio samples, creating a landmark piece of content that showcased the community's technology and drove massive engagement.
points: Designed and implemented an automated pipeline to showcase ~450 community-contributed RVC voice models, demonstrating their capabilities in a tangible way.
This content initiative served as a major catalyst for site traffic and user engagement, highlighting the power of creative technical showcases in community building.

cloud-infrastructure-devops-solutions.summary: Leveraged Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to build a scalable, resilient, and cost-effective infrastructure for all community platforms.
points: Deployed and managed all applications on Google Cloud Run for scalability and ease of use.
Utilized Cloud Build for CI/CD and Cloud SQL for robust data management.

title: Foundation Models Cheatsheet - Developer Education & Outreach
description: Partnered with researchers from Google, MIT, Stanford CRFM, and Hugging Face to translate a dense academic paper into an accessible, interactive web resource (fmcheatsheet.org) for the global developer community.
role_overview: Justin acted as the bridge between a consortium of AI researchers and the broader developer community. He led the initiative to transform the influential Foundation Model Development Cheatsheet into an interactive, open-source website. His role was to make critical information on responsible AI development accessible and engaging for practitioners worldwide.

custom-web-application-development.summary: Led the design and development of the interactive Hugo website, managing a collaborative process to translate complex academic content into a user-friendly format.
points: Built the platform from the ground up, creating an intuitive experience that significantly increased the paper's reach and impact.
Managed an iterative design process, incorporating multi-channel feedback from researchers at Google, MIT, Hugging Face, and others to create a cohesive and effective educational tool.

seo-content-strategy-optimization.summary: Structured the website's content and technical SEO to maximize its discoverability, ensuring this vital resource for responsible AI could be easily found by developers and researchers.
points: Built the website applying SEO best practices to ensure high visibility for practitioners searching for guidance on AI safety and ethics.
Designed a logical content architecture that improved both user navigation and search engine indexing.

role_overview: Justin was responsible for the development, enhancement, and security of the Stanford Graduate School of Business web ecosystem. A key part of his role involved proactively engaging with the external security researcher community to strengthen platform defenses, alongside building the digital experiences that connected the institution's diverse internal and external stakeholders.

points: Built and enhanced the primary web platforms used for communication and engagement with students, faculty, alumni, and prospective applicants.
Partnered with marketing and non-technical teams to align technical solutions with organizational storytelling and community outreach goals.

role_overview: As an active member of the security community, Justin proactively identifies and reports vulnerabilities to help organizations improve their security posture. This finding demonstrates a commitment to collaborative, ethical security practices.

His work centered on creating reliable, high-performance tools that made complex government data accessible to a broad community of users, enabling them to conduct research and hold officials accountable.

His role focused on creating a robust collaboration tool that enabled a diverse community of users across the Homeland Security Enterprise to share and utilize critical geospatial data.

Excelled at translating complex technical challenges for non-developer stakeholders, ensuring alignment between development efforts and user needs.
